context:
## Why AMBER and not RED

The computed colour was RED on the breach condition. A human override moved it to AMBER on the grounds that a workaround is in place. The override expires Jul 29 and is always shown with the computed colour beside it: "the machine says red, the lead says amber, because Y" is the useful sentence, and hiding either half breaks it.

## The honest dynamic range

One RED condition has no live input at all — it needs a per-ask blocking marker no source carries, so it is structurally untestable rather than merely unmet this week. Naming that is the difference between a verdict that was checked and one that could not be.

## Ask me about

Whether the override should be renewed or allowed to lapse to the computed colour, and what it would take to give the dormant condition a real input.
